values.task_boundary: Prepare and later coordinate only the approved release-tail graph, child evidence reconciliation, exact sprint review, and umbrella closeout.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #343 is terminal, canonical, ancestral, and clean before #308 executes.
AC-2: #309 remains active between terminal #308 and #310, and #310 consumes its reviewed post-deletion head and inventory.
AC-3: The child graph is exactly #308 through #319, acyclic, and assigns every included outcome to exactly one independently owned issue while allowing explicitly safe parallel lanes.

AC-4: Successor execution depends on the predecessor merge/readiness contract, not individual closeout bookkeeping; final #307 closeout reconciles terminal, canonical, ancestral, and cleanup truth for the complete child universe.
AC-5: Review findings are resolved or explicitly routed, and release documentation/claims agree with landed exact revisions and residual risks.
AC-6: WP-30's separately authorized tag/release ceremony is verified by live readback without duplicate or partial-state mutation.
AC-7: One exact-head sprint review passes, #307 closes truthfully, and v0.93 receives the accepted handoff without implicit activation.
AC-8: #268 is recorded as closed successfully and no longer blocks Sprint 6.
AC-9: #471 is recorded as a WP-27/#315 remediation subissue rather than an independent release-tail lane.
dependencies: Merge/readiness completion for predecessor-gated child execution
Terminal/canonical/cleanup reconciliation for final #307 closeout only
non_goals: Child implementation, repair, review execution, or publication
AWS, provider, tag, release, deployment, or v0.93 activation during preparation
Treating #309 as satisfied, optional, or deferred
Treating issue closeout as a successor dependency
Treating #471 as a release-tail sibling outside WP-27 remediation
